text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm Zenno Rob Roy. It's a pleasure 
to meet you...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The curtain on our story is finally about 
to rise...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I know that with you, Trainer, I can 
definitely become a hero... Because I 
believe in you! I look forward to your 
guidance...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
